support: Let students complete exactly six core lines with a visible word bank and one model line on screen.
challenge: Invite stronger learners to add the optional challenge line with a clear reason linked to fold placement or function.

activities.notes_for_app_design: Render as a teacher-reviewed structured writing card with the shared gallery visible as a reference and with separate saved line fields for the 6 required sentence-frame lines. Handle the challenge sentence as one separate optional field only. Show the teacher the required-elements checklist, common-error shortcuts, feedback prompts, and a return-for-revision flow for revising one line at a time. Do not use a paragraph text box and do not add any word-count requirement.

activities.title: Teacher Session: Explain a Pattern Piece
activities.summary: Students use the shared gallery and their writing card to explain one simple pattern piece aloud in a teacher-observed speaking routine.

en.title: Teacher Session: Explain a Pattern Piece
en.summary: Look at the pattern-piece gallery and explain one piece aloud in short English sentences.
en.instructions: Use the shared pattern-piece gallery and your description card. Say 5 to 6 short sentences aloud. Name the piece, say what garment it is for, name one marking, and say one or two simple actions.
success_criteria: I can say the piece name clearly.
I can use short clear patternmaking words in English.
I can include one marking and one action.

pt.summary: Observe a galeria de pattern piece e explique uma peca em voz alta com frases curtas em ingles.

Eu consigo incluir uma marcacao e uma acao.
